modelInput.utterance: What did the July 2 newspaper report about phone service?

output.text: The July second paper said the phones were out all over Knox. For hours, Jon. Still down when it went to press, too. Businesses closed. They hadn't announced a cause—there was talk of wires down, lightning, sabotage... but that's all it was. Talk.

reviewScope: Exact personified wording for this captured conversation; source fidelity and voice are reviewed separately.

verificationScope: Source chain is mechanically checked through sourceTaskSha256; this prose has human-readable factual alignment only and is not accepted by the version 3 exact-summary renderer.
voiceRationale: Short fragments and emphasis make the reported duration uneasy; she gives several relevant details without friendly reassurance or personal disclosure. This is one proposed realization, not a calibrated mapping from numeric traits to style. Jon's name identifies the supplied listener.
